originalTitle: 'Hostile act': Trump threatens EU with tariffs over Canada associate-membership proposal
summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU is opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.
content:
President Donald Trump on Wednesday threatened to impose tariffs on the European Union or halt trade with the bloc entirely if it proceeds with its plan to make Canada its first-ever "associate member."

"I think it's laughable ... Canada has been a terrible trade partner," Trump told reporters after landing in North Carolina. He conditioned his threat on the intention of European leaders, saying that "if I think it's at all a hostile act, I will put very serious tariffs or stop trading with Europe on many things."

Trump's remarks came after European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU was opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.

Associate membership doesn't currently exist as a formal category under EU treaties, and any such arrangement would need to be created and ratified by member states.

The proposal came as Brussels and Ottawa seek to deepen ties, signaling a significant shift in the EU, which had been lukewarm to Germany's proposal in May for granting an associate membership to Ukraine.

In her annual state of the EU address in Strasbourg, France, the EU chief said the bloc wants to bring the relationship with Canada "to the highest level possible."

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, who attended the address, has said in the past that Ottawa was keen to pursue a "unique security and economic alliance" with Europe, but not a full membership.

Canada has sought to diversify away from the U.S. following months of escalating trade tensions and as bilateral trade talks have collapsed . Trump has slapped a 50% tariff on Canadian goods and plans to ban the country's dairy, alcohol and auto imports later this month, drawing retaliation from Ottawa.

"Washington and Ottawa may find an off-ramp from the current trade war, but Canada will continue to reduce its vulnerability to U.S. economic pressure," said James Lindsay, a senior fellow at Council on Foreign Relations.

Von der Leyen's pitch to Canada includes joint work on manufacturing, integration of defense-industrial bases , a tech alliance, energy, artificial intelligence and cooperation in the Arctic.

Canada is already the only non-European country in the EU's SAFE instrument — an initiative that provides Canadian firms with preferential access to defense procurement — and has a free-trade agreement with the bloc, eliminating tariffs on roughly 99% of goods, though that deal still requires ratification by 10 EU states .

Any fresh U.S. tariffs on the EU would test the trade framework Washington and Brussels struck last year, which set a 15% tariff ceiling on most EU exports to the U.S.

Brussels hasn't said whether it will proceed with the associate-member proposal in the face of Trump's threat. EU member states — several of which were reportedly blindsided by the announcement — are yet to respond to Trump's threat.
chineseTitle: “敌对行为”：特朗普威胁欧盟就加拿大准成员国提案征收关税
chineseSummary: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，欧盟正在为加拿大成为27个成员国中的第一个准成员打开大门。
chineseContent:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三威胁称，如果欧盟继续实施让加拿大成为有史以来第一个“准成员”的计划，他将对欧盟征收关税或完全停止与欧盟的贸易。

“我认为这很可笑……加拿大一直是一个糟糕的贸易伙伴，”特朗普在抵达北卡罗来纳州后告诉记者。他以欧洲领导人的意图为条件发出威胁，称“如果我认为这完全是敌对行为，我将征收非常严厉的关税或停止与欧洲在许多事情上的贸易。”

特朗普发表上述言论之前，欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，欧盟正在为加拿大成为27个成员国中第一个准成员打开大门。

目前，准会员资格并不作为欧盟条约中的正式类别存在，任何此类安排都需要由成员国创建和批准。

该提议是在布鲁塞尔和渥太华寻求加深关系之际提出的，这标志着欧盟的重大转变，欧盟对德国五月份授予乌克兰准成员资格的提议态度冷淡。

欧盟主席在法国斯特拉斯堡举行的年度欧盟声明中表示，欧盟希望将与加拿大的关系“提升到尽可能的最高水平”。

出席讲话的加拿大总理马克·卡尼过去曾表示，渥太华热衷于与欧洲建立“独特的安全和经济联盟”，但不是正式成员国。

在贸易紧张局势持续数月升级且双边贸易谈判破裂后，加拿大寻求多元化，远离美国。特朗普对加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税，并计划本月晚些时候禁止该国的乳制品、酒类和汽车进口，招致渥太华的报复。

美国外交关系委员会高级研究员詹姆斯·林赛表示：“华盛顿和渥太华可能会找到摆脱当前贸易战的出口，但加拿大将继续降低其对美国经济压力的脆弱性。”

冯德莱恩向加拿大提出的倡议包括在制造、国防工业基地整合、技术联盟、能源、人工智能和北极合作方面的联合工作。

加拿大已经是欧盟 SAFE 工具中唯一的非欧洲国家，该计划为加拿大公司提供优先获得国防采购的机会，并且与欧盟签订了自由贸易协定，取消了大约 99% 的商品关税，不过该协议仍需要 10 个欧盟国家的批准。

美国对欧盟征收的任何新关税都将考验华盛顿和布鲁塞尔去年达成的贸易框架，该框架对大多数欧盟对美出口产品设定了 15% 的关税上限。

面对特朗普的威胁，布鲁塞尔尚未表示是否会继续执行准成员提案。据报道，欧盟成员国中的一些国家对这一声明感到措手不及，但尚未对特朗普的威胁做出回应。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
